description: TouchSocket.Http, the HTTP/1.1 server component of the TouchSocket networking framework. Requests are answered from an IHttpPlugin, which is how TouchSocket exposes its HTTP pipeline: the plugin sees each request, answers the ones it recognises and passes the rest along. HTTP/1.1 cleartext on :8080. /json is serialized from the parsed model on every request and compressed only when the client asked for it, so nothing is answered from a precomputed body. Disabled pending a fix: a request that arrives split across TCP segments AND asks for Connection: close is answered with nothing - the socket is closed instead of the response being flushed. Fragmented requests with keep-alive pass at every offset, so it is the close path specifically.
